turns: I can't log in after the app update. Can you help me get back into my account?
replies:
The help center shows that some users experienced temporary login issues after the app update that resolved on their own. Here's what to try:

- **Wait a bit** - If it's a known app update issue, it may resolve within a day or so
- **Clear the app cache** - Uninstall and reinstall the app, or clear app data/cache in your device settings
- **Use the web version** - Try logging in at brightside.com on a browser instead of the app
- **Reset your password** - Use the "Forgot Password" option to set a new password

**If those don't work**, please contact our support team directly with your order number (starts with BB-) and any error messages you're seeing. They can help troubleshoot further.

Is there anything else I can help with regarding your account?
